messages:
Ravi: Quick sync — deciding between a durable 'correlation ledger' vs an ephemeral per-request cache for stitching late-arriving attributes for cost attribution. Anyone got quick tradeoffs? RFC: https://go/rfc/trace-ledger
Sam: Ledger pros: deterministic backfills, easier audits, single source-of-truth for cross-region reconciliation. Cons: storage + write amplification and sharding complexity. Latency OK if writes are async and we compact later.
Jena: Ephemeral cache pros: minimal storage, simpler to roll out. Cons: loses late arrivals, hard to reconcile replays, and cross-region duplicates are a pain.
Michelle: We must not block the critical path — ledger writes need to be async. Suggest pattern: append-only ledger + local LRU hot cache for lookups, TTL + compaction so ledger doesn't grow forever.
Ravi: Good. Also thinking about query patterns: with ledger, query-side joins are simple (trace_id -> ledger entry). With ephemeral, we'd need a mapping service or delayed re-ingest to stitch, which complicates dashboards.
Sam: Example ledger entry we'd keep tiny: ```{"trace_id":"abc123","attrs":{"billing_key":"acct-7","tenant":"team-x"},"ingest_ts":1650000000}```. Keep attr set small and compress.
ingest-bot: ingest-bot: FYI current ingest ~12k traces/s per region. If ledger append is turned on for all traces, estimated write amplification ~+18-25% depending on batching.
Jena: Rough calc: 12k tps * 20 bytes(avg compressed entry) * 86400s = ~20.7 GB/day per region. With 7-day retention ~145 GB. Compression and delta-store could cut that by 3x.
Michelle: Also factor operational cost: index overhead, shard rebalancing, and egress for cross-region reconciliation. We should define storage SLOs and a compaction cadence before committing.
Sam: Alternative hybrid: only ledger for traces missing billing attrs at ingest time (i.e., capture misses). Most traces already carry billing keys so ledger writes would be a small fraction.
Ravi: Hybrid seems promising. Capture misses -> append ledger entry; do async reconciliation and materialize final billing attribution in analytics pipeline.
Jena: Actionable POC items: 1) perf test append latency & throughput for ledger (Sam). 2) implement local miss-capture + reconciliation window PoC (Jena). 3) cost projection + SLO impact (Michelle + finance).
Michelle: +1. Also add alerting: ledger write backlog, compaction lag, and cross-region reconciliation errors.
Ravi: I'll file a follow-up RFC with decision matrix and tag owners. Meeting Thu 10am to review perf numbers. @Sam @Jena please add perf targets and initial POC notes in the RFC. :thumbsup:
Sam: Will do — I'll include a small kbench for appends and simulate 12k tps with bursts.
Jena: I'll prototype the miss-capture flow and a reconciliation runner that replays events into the analytics join.
ingest-bot: ingest-bot: scheduled ingest snapshot upload complete (2026-03-22T02:15Z).
Michelle: Thanks. If hybrid narrows writes to <5% of traces then storage cost looks trivial, so that should be our default.
Ravi: Cool. Closing thread for now — RFC in a few hours.
